JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=118 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=5 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'

SELECT cp.subcategory, sum(f.quantity) AS units, count(*) AS lines, count(DISTINCT cp.sku) AS skus
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id=118 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period=5 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'

calls.statement:
SELECT p.sku, p.product_name, f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.quantity, f.net_amount, f.etl_loaded_at
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.subcategory='Fixings & Fasteners'
ORDER BY f.quantity DESC LIMIT 15

WITH m AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date AS dt, sum(f.quantity) AS units, sum(f.net_amount) AS net, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) AS receipts
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
 JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE s.store_id=118 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT d.calendar_date, d.is_trading_day, m.units, r.units_sold, m.net, r.net_sales_before_returns, m.receipts, r.receipts AS r_receipts
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN m ON m.dt=d.calendar_date
LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=d.calendar_date AND r.store_id=118
WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27' ORDER BY 1

SELECT cp.subcategory, cp.category, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 118
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 5
  AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
